user_story: As a user, I want the system to return an error when I try to get a task with a non-existent ID so that I know the task does not exist.

positive.title: Retrieve a task with a valid existing ID
steps: When the user requests a task with an existing valid ID
Then the system returns the task details
positive.expected_result: The system returns the details of the task corresponding to the specified ID

negative.title: Attempt to retrieve a task with a non-existent ID
steps: When the user requests a task with a non-existent ID
Then the system returns an error message
negative.expected_result: The system returns an error indicating that the task does not exist

edge.title: Attempt to retrieve a task with a null or empty ID
steps: When the user requests a task with a null or empty ID
Then the system returns an error message
edge.expected_result: The system returns an error indicating that the task ID is invalid
